name: Draenethyst Shard
summary: A Draenethyst Shard is a red crystal brought from the Swamp of Sorrows to the Gelkis centaur in Desolace. Uthek the Wise seeks its magic to strengthen the Gelkis against their enemies.

sections.title: A Red Crystal
sections.body: Uthek the Wise speaks of draenethyst as new to the earth, carried from a distant land where demons rule. He asks you to bring him a shard from the Swamp of Sorrows, held by Ongeku, whom the Gelkis call the lost one. Uthek believes its magic can aid his people against their enemies.

faq.answer: A Draenethyst Shard is a piece of red crystal that Uthek the Wise says came from a distant land ruled by demons.
Uthek the Wise of the Gelkis in Desolace wants the shard, believing its magic can strengthen his people.

faq.q: Where do I find a Draenethyst Shard?
faq.answer: Ongeku holds a Draenethyst Shard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Ongeku is the lost one who holds the Draenethyst Shard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Uthek believes the shard's magic will strengthen him and help the Gelkis fight their enemies.

angles.text: The Gelkis seek the shard in the Swamp of Sorrows, near Stonard, a Horde town in the southern swamp.
